content.short: Derive is an onchain options and futures protocol offering institutional-grade derivatives trading.
content.description: Derive runs options and futures markets on-chain, with a portfolio margin system that prices risk across a whole position rather than each leg separately. It was previously known as Lyra, and now operates on Hyperliquid among other venues. On-chain options have been harder to make work than perpetuals, because market makers need margining sophisticated enough to quote a surface rather than a single price.
